overview: A hiring and orientation roster for a restaurant opening team, with crew events, paperwork tracking, training groups and manager dashboards.
features: Create, edit, move, cancel and un-cancel crew events
Record each roadie's answer, reason, follow-up note and attendance per event
See going, can't go and no answer counts for every event
Flag roadies at risk of missing orientation on My crew and the Dashboard
See the next three upcoming events on Today
Fill a leader talk group while skipping roadies already in another group
